commit_message:
[Codegen][NFC] Move DropSchedulePass into Codegen/Common (#24501)

## Summary

Relocate `DropSchedulePass` from the soon-to-be retired
`llvm-external-projects/iree-dialects/` subproject into the in-tree
`iree::compiler::Codegen::Common` library, alongside the
transform-dialect interpreter pass that always pairs with it.

this is Sub-task #3 of #24466 (retire `transform.iree.match_callback`
and the broader `iree-dialects` project.
 
## Tested in a M2 Mac
- `bazel_to_cmake` regeneration reports 0 updates needed across all
modified directories (Bazel↔CMake parity).
- Repo-wide grep clean of `IREELinalgTransformDialectPasses`,
`mlir::linalg::transform::registerDropSchedulePass` , and
`iree-dialects/Dialect/LinalgTransform/Passes.h`.
- Local Release build of `iree-opt` on macOS arm64 (`cmake -G Ninja
-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ...` → `ninja iree-opt`) succeeded; 5136/5136
edges, exit 0.
- `iree-opt --help-list` shows the pass registered with the preserved
`--transform-dialect-drop-schedule` argument and original description
`"Drop the schedule from the operation"`.

---------

Signed-off-by: Alex-Wengg <hanweng9@gmail.com>
name: sdxl/clip_benchmark_cpu.json
